Magnetism Quirk.name: Magnetism Quirk
Magnetism Quirk.description:
🧲 You pull and push iron and steel, and you can give anything you touch a magnetic pole.

🌱 At the start you snatch a knife or a gun out of a hand from about ten meters, stop a thrown wrench in midair and slap an attacker away with a repelling push.
📈 With training: marked people locked to walls or each other, scrap storms, girder rides, falling beams caught, a car swung through a barricade, all the steel in a block.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Loss of Control, as a strained field grabs metal you never meant to move.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Magne (Magnetism).

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Combat Tactics +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Iron Snatch, Repulse Burst
Magnetism Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user pulls and pushes iron, steel and anyone or anything marked by touch. A new adult user moves steel within about ten meters, up to a person's weight (a knife, a manhole cover). Marks keep a user-picked pole for the scene; opposite marks within a few meters slam together, matching ones push apart. More needs techniques. Limits: aluminum, copper, plastic, wood, stone and unmarked flesh ignore it; most bullets (lead, copper) pass through. The user must see targets; the field wipes cards and scrambles nearby phones; scrap driven edge-first maims and is lethal force. Quirk Strain: light: snatch, shove; moderate: locking marks, scrap volley, glide; heavy: catching falling steel, swinging a car; severe: signature move, a block's steel. Type: Emitter. Law: hurling metal at people without a license is assault with a weapon; disrupting a pacemaker is endangering life. Look: loose metal twitches toward the user, a low hum, marks glow faintly, one color per pole.
